title: Polyploidy-mediated resilience in hepatic aging: molecular mechanisms and functional implication

evidence_spans.quote: This review explores the molecular mechanisms underlying hepatocyte polyploidization and its potential role in promoting resilience against the aging-related decline in liver function.

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: A review focused on molecular mechanisms in liver aging; multi-omics is not assessed after nonempirical report classification.
